name: Yugawara (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Yugawara town emblem in red: a ring enclosing a stylised leaf with a curved stroke.
history: Municipal flag of Yugawara, a town in Kanagawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 28 March 1961.

features.role: Yugawara town emblem — a ring enclosing a stylised leaf with a curved stroke
